text: All five shareholders of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor Co., Ltd. are state-owned enterprises, and the company's actual controller is the Chengdu Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Chengdu SASAC).
short: Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor's actual controller is the Chengdu municipal SASAC.

source.name: 川观新闻·川商传媒 (Cover News / Sichuan Daily's Chuanshang Media): 斥资5亿元！成都五大国企联手，布局这一赛道→
source.quote: 上述股东企业均具有国资背景，蓉酒酒业实际控制人为成都市国资委
source.note: Translation: 'The above shareholders all have state-owned backgrounds; Rongjiu Liquor's actual controller is the Chengdu Municipal SASAC.'

additionalSources.name: 钛媒体 via 新浪财经 (TMTPost via Sina Finance): 成都5亿元国资合资企业落地，国资产区平台成白酒第三极，与巨头共舞？
additionalSources.quote: 实际控制人为成都市国资委
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'The actual controller is the Chengdu Municipal SASAC.' The same article describes controlling shareholder Chengdu Industrial Investment Group as a large state-capital investment and operation platform established by the Chengdu municipal government.
